_readme: Per-pair external cross-check results (D6, checked 2026-09-07). The QC question is 'are we complete and correct under OUR stated definition (>=1 Big-5 top-flight league or CL appearance for both clubs, in our covered era)?' — NOT 'does our count match every website?'. missingButQualifying lists players external sources show who genuinely meet OUR definition AND era but are absent from our data (would block + require a data fix). Count gaps from cups / lower divisions / non-Big-5 leagues / pre-1992 English First Division & European Cup are documented scope differences, not errors. Era coverage: Premier League & Champions League from 1992; La Liga/Serie A from 1929, Ligue 1 from 1932, Bundesliga from 1963.

barcelona-and-real-madrid.coverageNote: All notable crossovers present (Figo, R9 Ronaldo, Luis Enrique, Laudrup, Schuster, Eto'o, Hagi, Prosinecki, Saviola). Our 28 spans La Liga back to 1929; higher published all-time totals include cup-only/reserve stints outside our league+CL scope.

ac-milan-and-inter.coverageNote: All notable crossovers present (Ibrahimović, R9 Ronaldo, Pirlo, Seedorf, R. Baggio, Vieri, Crespo, Balotelli, Çalhanoğlu, Bonucci). Our 53 = Serie A (from 1929) + CL; '100+ all-time' includes cups/lower tiers outside scope.

arsenal-and-chelsea.coverageNote: All notable crossovers present (Ashley Cole, Fàbregas, Čech, Giroud, Gallas, Willian, David Luiz, Petit, Sterling, Havertz). Our 17 = Premier League + CL.

chelsea-and-manchester-city.coverageNote: All notable crossovers present (De Bruyne, Sterling, Lampard, Kovačić, Anelka, Wright-Phillips, Sturridge, Aké). Our 20 counts league+CL only; external 23-26 counts any competitive appearance (adds cup-only players).

bayern-munich-and-borussia-dortmund.coverageNote: All notable crossovers present (Lewandowski, Hummels, Götze, Reuter, Perišić, Süle, Guerreiro, Rummenigge, Helmer, R. Kovač). Our 20 (Bundesliga from 1963 + CL) slightly EXCEEDS the commonly-cited 18.

chelsea-and-real-madrid.coverageNote: All notable crossovers present (Hazard, Courtois, Essien, Morata, Kovačić, Makélélé, Carvalho, Robben, Rüdiger, Higuaín, Geremi, Eto'o, Panucci). Our 17 = league+CL.

manchester-united-and-real-madrid.coverageNote: Notable crossovers present (Beckham, Cristiano Ronaldo, Di María, van Nistelrooy, Heinze, Chicharito, Casemiro, Varane). Our 10 = league+CL.

liverpool-and-manchester-united.coverageNote: Our 2 (Michael Owen, Paul Ince) is the Premier League / CL era. The other published names are pre-1992 English First Division and thus outside our covered era: Peter Beardsley (Liverpool 1987-91, Man Utd 1982-83), Phil Chisnall (1964), and early-1900s players (Chorlton, Sheldon, Hopkin) — documented scope difference, not a data gap to fix.

manchester-city-and-manchester-united.coverageNote: Our 5 (Schmeichel, Andy Cole, Tévez, Kanchelskis, Hargreaves) is the Premier League / CL era. Historical crossovers (Denis Law, Brian Kidd, Sammy McIlroy, Peter Barnes) are pre-1992 First Division — documented scope difference.

arsenal-and-tottenham.coverageNote: Our 4 (Sol Campbell, Adebayor, Gallas, David Bentley) is the Premier League / CL era. Pat Jennings (Spurs 1964-77, Arsenal 1977-85) is pre-1992 First Division — outside our covered era, documented scope difference, not a hidden gap.
